add.title: India-US trade agreement nears finalisation, says Piyush Goyal, as Washington proposes reducing tariffs from 25% to 17% subject to bilateral concessions
Finance Ministry introduces automatic GST registration cancellation from December 1 for eligible businesses with completed returns and cleared liabilities, reducing routine departmental scrutiny

Centre plans mandatory quality benchmarks and certification for cybersecurity products sold through government procurement platforms, covering security software, network equipment and digital forensic tools
Government revises national highway EPC bidding rules, linking contractor eligibility to performance ratings and project delays while tightening joint-venture requirements and performance guarantees

Centre prepares renewed parliamentary push for delimitation-linked women's reservation legislation, with regional-party support potentially determining whether the constitutional amendment secures the required majority
Pre-Budget consultations conclude with proposals for India-specific AI models, stronger MSME cybersecurity, biotechnology manufacturing, rural employment and expanded research and skilling support
RBI data shows external commercial borrowings by non-financial businesses more than doubled to ₹55,426 crore through October FY27, reflecting rising overseas financing activity
IRDAI's proposed insurance expense reforms could lower policyholder premiums while reshaping distributor commissions, agency economics and technology adoption across India's insurance sector
Labour Ministry revises investment rules for exempted provident fund trusts, permitting 5–15% equity allocation while introducing updated debt limits, contribution timelines and safeguards
Government's PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar programme reaches 6.91 million households and 20.2 GW capacity, with ₹37,989 crore disbursed in subsidies
RBI completes its first state-government bond switch auction, exchanging approximately ₹8,000 crore in securities and opening a new mechanism for managing state debt maturities
UK consumer-health multinational Haleon explores acquiring a controlling stake in India's HealthKart, potentially valuing the nutrition and supplements business at $1.2–1.4 billion
CERT-In issues high-severity security advisories covering WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business and ASUS software, warning of vulnerabilities affecting sensitive information, authentication and device security
